statement: Pinned hid-nintendo creates a separate IMU input node when the Pro controller is supported, with accelerometer ABS_X/Y/Z and gyro ABS_RX/RY/RZ, fuzz/resolution metadata and decoded three-sample reports.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Kernel IMU node capability and scaling are consumer-specific; cannot claim physical motion equivalence, SDL association or sensor axes without reference.
